newsitem.title: USA: Tosco shuts Avon, Calif., coker -- traders.
newsitem.headline: Tosco shuts Avon, Calif., coker -- traders.

text.p: Tosco Corp shut the 42,000 barrel-per-day (bpd) coker at its Avon, Calif., refinery east of San Francisco, earlier this week for planned maintenance, traders said.
The coker, which helps process 160,000 bpd of crude oil, is expected to stay out of service for up to 35 days, said a trader familiar with plant operations.
About 55,000 bpd of California heavy crude runs through the plant, and traders in recent days reported weaker prices as the refinery's inventory sold into the market and dropped demand.
"(Companies) are not buying on the spot market like they normally would," a trader said.
Prices for Kern River heavy crude ranged between postings and 20 cents under postings, but some traders talked barrels for February as low as 50 cents under.
